title: The Safehouse of Geneva
author: Lena Villalobos
blurb: Gideon Nystrom, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
